text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Still ain't enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I will not be satisfied with just this. 
More, I need more...!"

...After the race, a certain piece of news 
caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So, Mejiro McQueen-san, those rumors 
really are true, then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will also be competing in this 
year's Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
S-So! How are your adjustments coming 
along?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Without a hitch. I intend to approach it 
in prime condition, befitting the proud 
name of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
By the way, is the reason you decided to 
enter this race perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, who knows? I merely point the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The strength of the one who wears the 
crown of greatest stayer in history.

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: Ohh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I also heard that Mihono Bourbon-san will 
be running. Ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Are you looking forward to it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. We're running in it too— the 
'Tenno Sho (Spring).'"
choice_data_list:
It doesn't seem like it'll be 
straightforward, though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's why you're going, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If you were the kind of person who'd 
chicken out here, we wouldn't have made it 
this far together."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...By the way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"How long do you plan to stay in my room? 
I'd like to get changed soon."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I understand your overly worrying nature 
all too well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I know those eyes are always watching me. 
But I will not repeat that summer again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't worry. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If you understand, then be on your way.

—And so, in search of a battle against the 
strongest, we set our course toward the 
Tenno Sho (Spring).
